FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Minnesota fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Visiting children under 16 must use a parent's or guardian's licence or obtain a youth licence.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-12

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older.
  • Visiting children under 16 who do not fish under a parent's or guardian's licence.

Who doesn’t

  • Non-resident children under 16 can fish under a parent's or guardian's licence; applicable shared limits remain.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 24-hournon resident24 hours$14 USD
Non-resident 72-hournon resident72 hours$36 USD
Non-resident 7-daynon resident7 consecutive days$43 USD
Non-resident annual adultnon residentThrough February 28, 2027$51 USD
Non-resident youth, ages 0–17non residentThrough February 28, 2027$5 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Trout/Salmon Stamp Validation · $10 USD
    Applies to anglers aged 18–64 in designated waters or for trout/salmon harvest where required. The 24-hour, 72-hour and youth licenses are exempt.

Rules visitors should know

  • Buy a youth licence for a visiting child's separate limit, unless a family licence provides it.
  • Species seasons and limits still apply with an all-year licence.

How to buy

Use the Minnesota DNR online licence shop.

License-free days

January 16–18, 2027: Minnesota residents may fish without a license when accompanied by a child aged 15 or younger. This resident exemption does not cover visiting adults.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Minnesota?

Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Visiting children under 16 must use a parent's or guardian's licence or obtain a youth licence.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Minnesota?

Non-resident 24-hour: $14 USD; Non-resident 72-hour: $36 USD; Non-resident 7-day: $43 USD; Non-resident annual adult: $51 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Minnesota?

Use the Minnesota DNR online licence shop.
